name: Milky Way
description: The Solar System, the Sun's neighbourhood and the Milky Way in one continuous 3D zoom, from real data only: JPL's planets and the Moon for any date from 1900 to 2100, and 21 moons from 1950 to 2050, with time playback; stars in 3D, mostly at Gaia distances; and the galaxy's measured clusters, streams and satellite galaxies, entirely offline.
